_what: Which of a service's accounts is the one used first, and what each account's sign-in allowed, in plain groups. `primary` is the account fact the choice is kept in and when the tag shows: a service with fewer than `min_accounts` accounts has nothing to choose between, and one with no choice made uses its earliest connected account. `scope_groups` names a group of access in words and the pieces of a provider's reported permission text that mean it; an account's sign-in shows a group as allowed when any of its permissions contains one of the pieces, and shows groups only for a sign-in that reported its permissions and allowed at least one of them. A new group is a row here; nothing that reads them changes.

primary.said: {account} is now the {service} account Trillion uses first.
primary.not_found: That account is not one you can make primary.

scope_groups.title: What this sign-in allowed
scope_groups.hint: Sign in again to allow what is not allowed.
